name: app-website
description: Monorepo for app website with backend and frontend

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @app/contracts build && pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.check: pnpm check:no-specs && node tools/check-modelscope-config.cjs && pnpm type-check && pnpm lint:check
scripts.lint:check: pnpm --filter backend lint:check && pnpm --filter frontend lint:check
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --filter backend lint:fix && pnpm --filter frontend lint:fix
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter @app/contracts build && pnpm --filter backend type-check && pnpm --filter frontend type-check
